name: CVE-2026-77790 - RegistrationMagic WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-77790 - RegistrationMagic WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The RegistrationMagic plugin for WordPress before 6.0.9.4 is vulnerable to SQL injection via the 'rm_sortby' GET parameter on the admin page /wp-admin/admin.php?page=rm_form_manage. The parameter is used unsanitised in a SQL statement; a backtick breaks out of the identifier quoting, allowing a time-based blind injection. The request places a backtick-breakout sub-select SLEEP payload in rm_sortby. Authenticated (admin, or a lower role granted page access). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the WPScan advisory.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/42c48c95-1384-4414-9236-64f44bea9027/ (advisory / PoC - rm_sortby, rm_form_manage)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77790 (CVE record)

description:

WooCommerce before 11.0 is vulnerable to authenticated (Shop Manager+) blind SQL injection via the date_type parameter of the Analytics Orders Stats REST endpoint (GET /wp-json/wc-analytics/reports/orders/stats). The value (also settable via the woocommerce_date_type option) is interpolated as a date column name into the report SQL without validation against a known-column allowlist. This request sends a time-based SLEEP subquery in date_type. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the fix PR diff.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce/pull/67554 (fix PR, sanitize_date_column_name on date_type)
- https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/woocommerce/vulnerability/wordpress-woocommerce-plugin-10-9-4-sql-injection-vulnerability (advisory)

Unsanitized input is interpolated into a MySQL query; the real exploit chains INTO DUMPFILE for RCE. This request sends a proof-only time-based blind payload (AND SLEEP) in userRes; the path username segment is a required valid-account placeholder (shown as /user/). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the KIS-2026-12 / VulnCheck advisory.

An authenticated administrator reaches it via POST /admin/api/stopword/save with the stopWord JSON field. This request sends a UNION SELECT in the stopWord value. description:

The orderBy and sortOrder request parameters are concatenated into the ORDER BY clause of a SQL query without sufficient validation, allowing an authenticated user to inject arbitrary SQL and, on MySQL/MariaDB, disclose files via LOAD_FILE(). The limit field is destructured from the unvalidated JSON request body (bypassing the Zod schema) and interpolated directly into a Cloudflare Analytics Engine SQL query via a LIMIT ${limit} template literal. The request sends a UNION ALL SELECT payload against system.tables in the limit field. Built from the GitHub Security Advisory and VulnCheck PoC.

name: CVE-2026-55509 - WsgiDAV MySQLBrowserProvider SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-55509 - WsgiDAV MySQLBrowserProvider SQL Injection
description:

The request sends a boolean-based payload (0' OR '1'='1) in the URL path key. Built from the GitHub Security Advisory PoC. Note: file-content/path inspection by WAFs varies; this is a path-based SQLi signature.

name: CVE-2026-54350 - Budibase NoSQL Injection

description:

name: CVE-2026-41581 - Frappe Framework Blog List SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41581 - Frappe Framework Blog List SQL Injection
description:
Frappe Framework before 15.106.0 / 16.16.0 is vulnerable to SQL injection in get_blog_list (frappe/website/doctype/blog_post/blog_post.py), which builds the blog listing query with Python str.format() and inserts the pagination values limit_start and limit_page_length into the LIMIT/OFFSET clause WITHOUT escaping (txt/category/blogger are db.escape()'d, the limit values are not). get_blog_list is reached over HTTP through the guest-allowed web-list method frappe.www.list.get for doctype "Blog Post"; the request sends a UNION SELECT payload in the limit_start parameter. name: CVE-2026-41478 - Saltcorn Mobile Sync SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41478 - Saltcorn Mobile Sync SQL Injection
description:
Saltcorn before 1.4.6 / 1.5.6 / 1.6.0-beta.5 contains a SQL injection in the mobile-sync routes. In the POST /sync/load_changes handler, the value req.body.syncInfos[<tableName>].maxLoadedId is interpolated directly into the SQL WHERE clause in getSyncRows() without casting or binding (the fix casts it with Number() and binds it as $1). Any authenticated low-privilege user with read access to at least one table can inject arbitrary SQL. The request sends a UNION SELECT payload in syncInfos.users.maxLoadedId via a JSON body. name: CVE-2026-41457 - OwnTone Server DAAP Query SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41457 - OwnTone Server DAAP Query SQL Injection
description:
OwnTone Server 28.4 through 29.0 contain a SQL injection in DAAP query/filter handling. For integer-mapped DAAP fields, the value is appended verbatim to the SQL string in sql_append_dmap_clause (src/parsers/daap_parser.y) via sql_append(result, "%s", v->data) with no numeric validation; the fix parses the value with strtoll. The query=/filter= parameters are read by query_params_set() for endpoints such as /databases/N/items. The request sends a DAAP query on an integer field (dmap.itemid) with a UNION SELECT injected after the colon. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the fix commit and source analysis.

References used to recreate this request:

name: CVE-2026-41453 - Krayin CRM Lead DataGrid Blind SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-41453 - Krayin CRM Lead DataGrid Blind SQL Injection
description:
Krayin CRM before 2.2.4 contains a blind SQL injection in the leads DataGrid (packages/Webkul/Admin/src/DataGrids/Lead/LeadDataGrid.php), where request()->input('rotten_lead.in') is concatenated directly into a havingRaw() call without binding or casting (the fix uses a ? placeholder with an (int) cast). name: CVE-2026-2412 - expresstech Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-2412 - expresstech Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) SQL Injection
description:

The REST create/save question handlers (quiz-survey-master/v1/questions/) store merged_question as 'linked_question' only sanitize_text_field()'d; it is later split on commas and concatenated into an IN(...) clause in qsm_rest_get_questions without intval()/prepare(). description:

name: CVE-2026-2024 - savitasoni PhotoStack Gallery WordPress Plugin SQL Injection

description:

name: CVE-2025-11740 - tomdever wpForo Forum SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-11740 - tomdever wpForo Forum SQL Injection
description:
The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress <= 2.4.9 is vulnerable to SQL injection via the Subscriptions Manager (authenticated, Subscriber+). Source review confirms the subscription args are taken from $_REQUEST['sbscrb'] in modules/subscriptions/Subscriptions.php and flow into the subscriptions SQL query. The request sends a time-based SQL injection payload in the sbscrb parameter. sbscrb is a $_REQUEST superglobal read on the forum front end; the path is shown as the WordPress front controller '/' (path flagged as generic since the forum page slug is site-specific) and method GET is used ($_REQUEST accepts it). A dummy logged-in cookie is included. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the Wordfence advisory and the trac fix changeset.

References used to recreate this request:

name: CVE-2025-11452 - Asgaros Forum WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-11452 - Asgaros Forum WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The Asgaros Forum WordPress plugin (<= 3.1.0) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the asgarosforum_unread_exclude cookie. The cookie is JSON-decoded in includes/forum-unread.php and its keys/values are concatenated unsanitized into SQL (includes/forum-content.php: "...WHERE p.parent_id = {topic_id} AND p.id > {excluded_items[topic_id]}..."). The request loads the forum unread view with a UNION SELECT/SLEEP payload inside the cookie. Cookie vector and SQL sink confirmed from the plugin source via gh code search and the fix commit. The forum page is site-specific, so the /?view=unread path is a representative trigger (flagged); the injection is in the Cookie header, which the WAF inspects regardless of path. No vendor WAF rule found.

name: CVE-2025-10046 - ELEX WooCommerce Google Shopping (Google Product Feed) SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2025-10046 - ELEX WooCommerce Google Shopping (Google Product Feed) SQL Injection
description:
The ELEX WooCommerce Google Shopping (Google Product Feed) plugin for WordPress (<= 1.4.3) is vulnerable to authenticated SQL injection via the 'file_to_delete' POST parameter of the admin-ajax action 'elex_gpf_manage_feed_remove_file'. The plugin source (includes/elex-manage-feed-ajax.php) interpolates file_to_delete into "DELETE FROM {prefix}gpf_feeds WHERE feed_id= $id" with only sanitize_text_field (no digit restriction, no real prepared binding), so a time-based SQLi payload reaches the query. References used to recreate this request:
- https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/0afe37bb-fa8a-4e7b-93c6-c44b3fbeb904?source=cve (Wordfence advisory)
- https://plugins.svn.wordpress.org/elex-woocommerce-google-product-feed-plugin-basic/tags/1.4.3/includes/elex-manage-feed-ajax.php (vulnerable source: action elex_gpf_manage_feed_remove_file, $_POST['file_to_delete'] into DELETE query)
- https://plugins.trac.wordpress.org/changeset/3342699/elex-woocommerce-google-product-feed-plugin-basic/tags/1.4.4/includes/elex-manage-feed-ajax.php (fix changeset)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-10046 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2026-15462 - gingerplugins Sticky Chat Widget SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-15462 - gingerplugins Sticky Chat Widget SQL Injection
description:
The Sticky Chat Widget plugin for WordPress (<= 1.4.2) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the array KEYS of the 'scw_form_fields' POST parameter in the 'scw_save_form_data' AJAX action. save_form_data() passes attacker-controlled POST array keys unsanitized to $wpdb->insert(), which wraps column identifiers in backticks without escaping, so a backtick in a key breaks out of the column-identifier list into raw SQL. The request sends a malicious backtick+subquery key to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php (nonce is a dummy; the action is registered for nopriv). No vendor WAF rule found; built from plugin source and the Wordfence advisory.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://plugins.svn.wordpress.org/sticky-chat-widget/tags/1.4.2/includes/front-end.php (vulnerable source: scw_save_form_data / save_form_data / $wpdb->insert)
- https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/35a49ba9-02a6-47cf-98f0-053b06036b08?source=cve (advisory)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15462 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2024-49773 - SalesAgility SuiteCRM SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2024-49773 - SalesAgility SuiteCRM SQL Injection
description:
SalesAgility SuiteCRM before 7.14.6 / 8.7.1 is vulnerable to authenticated blind SQL injection through the `current_post` parameter of the export entry point. The value of current_post is passed unsanitised into generateSearchWhere() (confirmed in export.php: $currentQuery = generateSearchWhere($the_module, $_REQUEST['current_post'])), so a search field embedded in current_post is injected into the WHERE clause. The request POSTs to index.php?entryPoint=export with a current_post value that URL-decodes to a boolean SQLi (name=' OR 1=1-- -), matching OWASP CRS 942 on ARGS:current_post. No vendor WAF rule found; built from the GHSA advisory and the SuiteCRM source.

- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-49773 (CVE record)

displayName: CVE-2024-27299 - thorsten phpMyFAQ SQL Injection
description:

name: CVE-2024-27298 - parse-community Parse Server SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2024-27298 - parse-community Parse Server SQL Injection
description:
Parse Server before 6.5.0 is vulnerable to SQL injection on the PostgreSQL storage adapter through the literalizeRegexPart function, which fails to safely escape the value of a $regex query constraint. The REST query API at /parse/classes/<ClassName> is the only HTTP path that reaches this function, via a where clause containing a $regex operator; this request sends a $regex value of "') OR 1=1-- -" on the _User class. No public PoC request was available, so the path (/parse/classes/_User), the where/$regex parameter and the GET method are reconstructed from the advisory's named root cause (literalizeRegexPart / $regex) and Parse Server's documented REST query API; HTTP method inferred (GET read query). No vendor WAF rule found.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6927-3vr9-fxf2 (advisory)
- https://github.com/parse-community/parse-server/security/advisories/GHSA-6927-3vr9-fxf2 (vendor advisory)

- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-27298 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2024-13507 - GeoDirectory SQL Injection

description:

name: CVE-2024-7651 - appcheap App Builder WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2024-7651 - appcheap App Builder WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The App Builder - Create Native Android & iOS Apps On The Flight plugin for WordPress (<= 4.3.3) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the 'app-builder-search' GET parameter handled in includes/pure.php. The source reads filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'app-builder-search') and concatenates it into a MATCH (...) AGAINST ('$search') query without $wpdb->prepare(). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the Wordfence advisory and the plugin source (confirmed GET parameter and injection point).

name: CVE-2024-7385 - WordPress Simple HTML Sitemap Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2024-7385 - WordPress Simple HTML Sitemap Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The WordPress Simple HTML Sitemap plugin (<= 3.1) is vulnerable to authenticated (Administrator) SQL injection via the 'id' parameter on the wshs_saved admin page. In inc/wshs_saved.php the delete path concatenates $_REQUEST['id'] into a DELETE ... WHERE id = <id> query via $wpdb->prepare() with no placeholders, so the numeric value is injectable. The request sends a time-based SQLi payload (AND SLEEP(5)) in 'id' at admin.php?page=wshs_saved&action=delete. HTTP method GET matches the delete link generated by the plugin. A dummy auth cookie is included to match the authenticated request shape (the WAF inspects before the app). No vendor WAF rule found; built from the plugin source and advisory.

name: CVE-2026-11823 - Repute Infosystems BookingPress Appointment Booking Pro SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-11823 - Repute Infosystems BookingPress Appointment Booking Pro SQL Injection
description:
BookingPress Appointment Booking Pro for WordPress through 5.7.1 is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the 'store_service_date' POST parameter in the bpa_assign_staffmember_to_slots() function, which runs stripslashes_deep() on the value and interpolates it into a SQL LIKE clause without $wpdb->prepare(). - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-11421 (NVD record)

name: CVE-2026-9829 - Photo Gallery by 10Web WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-9829 - Photo Gallery by 10Web WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
Photo Gallery by 10Web (<= 1.8.41) is vulnerable to authenticated (contributor+) time-based SQL injection via the 'compact_album_order_by' shortcode parameter. The payload is stored through the 'shortcode_bwg' admin-ajax handler (reachable by contributors, and without a nonce when 'page' is omitted) and later executed by the unauthenticated 'bwg_frontend_data' handler in an ORDER BY clause. This request is the storing request: it sends a time-based SLEEP payload in compact_album_order_by to admin-ajax.php?action=shortcode_bwg. name: CVE-2026-7815 - pgAdmin 4 Maintenance Tool SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-7815 - pgAdmin 4 Maintenance Tool SQL Injection
description:
pgAdmin 4 before 9.15 concatenates user-supplied Maintenance Tool JSON fields (buffer_usage_limit, vacuum_parallel, vacuum_index_cleanup, reindex_tablespace) directly into the rendered VACUUM/ANALYZE/REINDEX command. An authenticated user with tools_maintenance permission can break out of the BUFFER_USAGE_LIMIT "<value>" option and inject arbitrary SQL. The request is a POST to /maintenance/job/{sid}/{did} whose JSON body carries a quote-breakout SELECT pg_sleep(5) payload in buffer_usage_limit (proof-only; the real bug can escalate via COPY ... TO PROGRAM). No vendor WAF rule found; endpoint, field and template confirmed via GitHub code search of the pgadmin4 source.

References used to recreate this request:
- https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/issues/9898 (issue)
- https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/blob/master/web/pgadmin/tools/maintenance/__init__.py (endpoint /maintenance/job/<sid>/<did>, field buffer_usage_limit)
- https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/blob/master/web/pgadmin/tools/maintenance/templates/maintenance/sql/command.sql (template: BUFFER_USAGE_LIMIT "<value>")
- https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-7815 (NVD)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-7815 (CVE record)

displayName: CVE-2026-7797 - Simply Schedule Appointments WordPress Plugin SQL Injection

- https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-7797 (NVD)
- https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-7797 (CVE record)

name: CVE-2022-36272 - Mingsoft MCMS SQL Injection

description:

name: CVE-2022-35947 - GLPI SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2022-35947 - GLPI SQL Injection
description:
GLPI before 10.0.3 is vulnerable to SQL injection in the external-token login flow of the REST API: the 'user_token' value is taken from $_REQUEST and used to build a token-lookup SQL query (getFromDBbyToken) without proper validation, allowing an attacker to simulate an arbitrary user login. This request sends a classic OWASP CRS 942 SQL injection signature in the user_token query parameter of apirest.php/initSession. displayName: CVE-2026-5651 - 2wstechnologies Askeet WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
description:
The Askeet plugin for WordPress (<= 3.0) is vulnerable to authenticated (Administrator+) SQL injection via the sql_query parameter in the askeet_execute_sql_query AJAX action. The askeet_is_safe_query() filter strips regular block comments before keyword checks but MySQL executes conditional comments, so the request sends a /*!50000UNION*/ SELECT payload (proof-only read of wp_users) that bypasses the filter. description:

name: CVE-2026-4352 - Crocoblock JetEngine SQL Injection
displayName: CVE-2026-4352 - Crocoblock JetEngine SQL Injection
description:
The JetEngine plugin for WordPress (<= 3.8.6.1) is vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection via the Custom Content Type (CCT) REST API search endpoint. The _cct_search GET parameter is interpolated into a SQL query via sprintf() without $wpdb->prepare(), and wp_unslash() strips the magic-quotes protection, enabling single-quote-based injection. The request sends a single-quote UNION SELECT payload in _cct_search against the CCT REST route /wp-json/jet-cct/{slug}/. Source: Wordfence advisory. The CCT slug (here 'team', the Crocoblock docs example) is install-specific - flagged, as any publicly-exposed CCT GET endpoint is affected.
